about.title: A little about me
about.intro: I’m Sriram. I’m curious about how people learn, how technology changes our choices, and how we make sense of work and life. I write to think those questions through—and to leave room for another point of view.
about.background: I’ve spent nearly three decades across technology, business and capability development. That experience is part of the context for my writing. Here, I’m interested in the questions that connect those worlds: how we make decisions, what helps people grow, and what deserves our attention.
beliefs: Good questions deserve patience, especially when a quick answer feels reassuring.
Experience can offer perspective; it can also make assumptions harder to see.
Technology raises questions about people and responsibility as well as capability.
Learning includes being willing to revise what we think we know.
about.independence: This is my personal website. The views here are my own and do not represent an employer or organisation.

contact.title: A note is welcome
contact.body: An idea that stayed with you, a different perspective, a source I should read, or a correction I should make—thoughtful notes are welcome.
